name: 新兵營
status: pending: the card borrows supply_depot.png until this art exists (balance.gd "art":"supply_depot"). When the picture is in, save it as recruit_camp.png here, remove the "art" field, run tools/prepare_assets.gd and --import.
prompt: Production 2D game building illustration in a consistent medieval illuminated manuscript style: fine dark sepia ink outline, hand-drawn hatching, muted ochre/olive/ivory tempera pigments, restrained textured pigment INSIDE the subject, flattened illustrative perspective, strange historically-inspired marginalia rather than generic modern fantasy. A small rustic militia recruiting camp for a frontier village: one open-fronted timber drill shed with a steep thatched roof on stout posts, a rack of plain wooden spears and a few round wooden practice shields leaning against it, a straw training dummy on a pole in front, a low split-rail fence, and a tall pole flying a long swallowtail pennant. The pennant and a cloth awning stripe are opaque vermilion fabric for runtime team recoloring; avoid red in wood, thatch, straw and earth. Compact coherent cluster seen from a slight elevated three-quarter angle, the open front facing RIGHT toward the battlefield, shallow manuscript perspective rather than modern isometric 3D. Structure complete and intact, no ruins. No people, no soldiers, no text, no frame, no sky, no landscape backdrop. Small irregular earthy footprint directly beneath the structure only; true transparent alpha background everywhere else. Entire camp inside the canvas with 8% transparent padding, nothing cropped. Silhouette must read as 'a place that trains soldiers' at 100 pixels and must not look like the supply depot stall (no crates, no sacks).
